components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-brand-2); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-brand-2); color: #fff; padding: 8px 24px; font: 500 14px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-1); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Trigger
components.description: Square rail control that opens keyboard-first search.
components.css: .ds-search-trigger { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-divider); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-bg-soft); color: var(--color-text-3); padding: 6px 12px; font: 14px var(--font-sans); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-search-trigger svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-search-trigger span { flex: 1; } .ds-search-trigger:hover { border-color: var(--color-border); color: var(--color-text-2); } .ds-search-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-3); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-search-trigger kbd { border: 1px solid var(--color-divider); padding: 2px 6px; font: 12px var(--font-mono); }

components.name: Topic Ledger Row
components.description: Full-width topic record with evidence at the right edge.
components.css: .ds-topic-row { display: grid; width: 100%; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 190px; gap: 16px; align-items: center; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-divider); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-bg-soft); color: var(--color-text-1); padding: 17px 20px; font-family: var(--font-sans); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-topic-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-2) 7%, transparent); } .ds-topic-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-3); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-topic-row strong { display: block; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-topic-row small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--color-text-2); font-size: 14px; } .ds-topic-progress { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; color: var(--color-mastered); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-topic-progress i { height: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-divider); } .ds-topic-progress b { display: block; width: 50%; height: 100%; background: var(--color-mastered); } .ds-topic-progress em { font-style: normal; }

components.name: Review Ledger Item
components.description: Compact review queue record with a reason dot.
components.css: .ds-review-item { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 68px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-divider); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-bg-soft); color: var(--color-text-1); padding: 11px 14px; font-family: var(--font-sans); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-review-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-2) 7%, transparent); } .ds-review-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-3); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-review-item i { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: 0 0 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-brand-3); } .ds-review-item strong { flex: 1; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-review-item small { color: var(--color-text-3); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Mastery Progress Rule
components.description: Segmented evidence rule for existing learning states.
components.css: .ds-mastery { background: var(--color-bg-soft); color: var(--color-text-2); padding: 24px; font: 14px var(--font-sans); } .ds-mastery p { margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-mastery strong { color: var(--color-text-1); font-size: 24px; } .ds-mastery p > b { color: var(--color-mastered); font-size: 24px; } .ds-mastery div { display: flex; height: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-divider); } .ds-mastery i { height: 100%; } .ds-mastery i:nth-child(1) { width: 50%; background: var(--color-mastered); } .ds-mastery i:nth-child(2) { width: 17%; background: var(--color-progress); } .ds-mastery i:nth-child(3) { width: 17%; background: var(--color-brand-2); } .ds-mastery i:nth-child(4) { width: 16%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-3) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Ruled Dialog
components.description: Flat modal shell for search and quiz work.
components.html:
Search notes
Up/Down navigate Enter open
components.css: .ds-dialog { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-divider); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-bg-elv); color: var(--color-text-1); font: 14px var(--font-sans); } .ds-dialog header, .ds-dialog footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-divider); } .ds-dialog header button { display: grid; width: 24px; height: 24px; margin-left: auto; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-3); cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog header button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-dialog header button:hover { color: var(--color-text-1); } .ds-dialog header button:focus-visible, .ds-dialog input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-3); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-dialog input { display: block; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-divider); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-1); padding: 16px; font: 16px var(--font-sans); caret-color: var(--color-brand-3); } .ds-dialog footer { border-bottom: 0; color: var(--color-text-3); font-size: 12px; } .ds-dialog kbd { font-family: var(--font-mono); }

narrative.overview:
Learn Anything is an operational academic folio: a calm, dense study workspace built from archival paper, deep ink, and visible ledger rules. It supports local, evidence-led learning with editorial restraint rather than SaaS ceremony.

The paper texture is CSS-native and deliberately low contrast. Functional color marks real study state while the interface stays primarily paper and ink. Keyboard operation remains explicit through square controls, semantic labels, and a visible focus outline.
keyCharacteristics: Archival paper surfaces and low-contrast fiber marks.
Serif-first reading and tabular numeric evidence.
Flat, ruled structure instead of card-wall elevation.
Functional indigo, coral, moss, and ochre accents.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve colored marks for a state, action, or evidence category; paper, ink, and rules do the structural work.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep pedagogical prose at the established `72ch` measure; use the wider canvas for navigation and evidence, not longer lines of study text.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Convey hierarchy with borders, typography, and tonal paper surfaces; do not introduce drop shadows or backdrop blur.

rules.name: The Ruled Edge Rule
rules.body: Use square boundaries and 1px rules for workspace structure; reserve rounding for small local affordances where the implementation already uses it.

dos: Do use paper tone, ink hierarchy, and 1px rules before adding decoration.
Do reserve serif for interface and learning prose, and mono for code and keyboard hints.
Do keep interaction states keyboard-visible with the established red-pencil focus outline.
Do use the CSS-native paper texture as an optional tonal layer only.
donts: Don't use shadows, blur, or floating card-wall compositions for the core workspace.
Don't use colored accents as decoration; attach them to navigation, action, or evidence.
Don't let long-form instructional prose exceed the established reading measure.
Don't make the texture necessary for legibility or contrast.
